The Cuts

The Executive$60

45 min

The house specialty. Wash and cut, shaped entirely with shears — no clippers, no guards — every line judged by eye and cut by hand. It takes longer, and it should: the result grows out softer, sits more naturally, and never leaves a hard shelf across the back.

Book this service →
The Signature$50

40 min

Wash and cut. Electric clippers and traditional shears working together, seamlessly blended. A gentle hand throughout — nobody should leave a haircut feeling roughed up.

Book this service →
The Fresh Fade$50

40 min

Wash and cut. A clippers-only skin fade, blended by hand from a bare skin line up through the longer hair on top — a graduated blend rather than one uniform length, with sharp edges and a clean modern finish.

Book this service →
The Regiment$45

30 min

Wash and cut. The classic crew cut — clippers only, short through the back and sides with a bit more length left on top. A uniform short length rather than a skin fade, so it keeps its shape as it grows. Easy to maintain, endlessly versatile, always a neat and clean finish.

Book this service →
The Royal Roots$40

30 min

Wash and cut for my youngest gentlemen, ages 12 and under. Patient, unhurried, and taken as seriously as any cut in the chair. Kids notice when someone takes their time with them.

Which cut is yours?

A quick guide

Scissors only

The Executive. Shaped entirely with shears, no clippers at all. Grows out softer. 45 min.

Clippers and shears

The Signature. Both tools, blended so you can't see where one stops. 40 min.

A skin fade

The Fresh Fade. Clippers only, from a bare skin line up. 40 min.

Short and even

The Regiment. The classic crew cut, uniform rather than faded. 30 min.

Ages 12 and under

The Royal Roots. Patient and unhurried. 30 min.

Common Questions

Is a wash included?

Yes. Every haircut on my menu includes a wash.

What makes The Executive different?

It's cut entirely with shears, no clippers and no guards, with every line judged by eye. That takes longer, about 45 min, and the result grows out softer and sits more naturally.

Do you cut children's hair?

Yes. The Royal Roots is a wash and cut for my youngest gentlemen, ages 12 and under. Patient, unhurried, and taken as seriously as any cut in the chair.

Can I add a shave or beard work to my cut?

Yes. My packages pair a cut with a hot towel shave or beard shaping for less than booking them separately, from $80 to $120. You'll find them on the hot towel shaves page.
